FOREIGN AFFAIRS GROUP (CHANGE IN NOMENCLATURE), RULES, 1983
FOREIGN AFFAIRS GROUP (CHANGE IN NOMENCLATURE), RULES, 1983
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 5th October, 1983]
S. R. O. 936 (1)/83.-In exercise
of the powers conferred by section 25 of the Civil Servants Act, 1973(LXXI of
1973) the President is pleased to make the following rules, namely :-
1. (1) These rules may be
called the Foreign Affairs Group (Change in Nomenclature) Rules, 1983.
(2) They shall come into force at
once. .
2. Notwithstanding
anything contained in the Civil Servants (Change in Nomenclature of Services
and Abolition of Classes) Rules, 1973, or any ins tructions or orders on the
subject, the Foreign Affairs Group shall henceforth be called the Foreign
Service of Pakistan.
3. All references to
Foreign Affairs Group in any rule, order resolution or instruction shall,
unless the subject or context otherwise requires, be Cons trued as reference to
the Foreign Service of Pakistan.
